subject: ClearWay DR evidence: RTO/RPO mapping and witness plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@clearwaybank.com>, controls@clearwaybank.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWay DR evidence: RTO/RPO mapping and witness plan

Hi Lena / Controls team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As requested, attached is a compact evidence package focused on our RTO/RPO commitments and demonstrable artifacts you can use for SIG/CAIQ review:

- redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf (one-page mapping of service tiers to measured RTO/RPO)
- runbook-extracts.txt (sanitized excerpts from our failover and restore runbooks)
- kvs-snapshot-times.csv (timestamped KV cache snapshot durations from the last 90 days)

Quick notes:
- RTO targets are shown per logical service (API ingress, streaming generation, KV cache rebuild).
- RPO is primarily a function of our KV checkpoint cadence; we've included representative timestamps.
- We have a proposed live witness approach (warm-cache witness + restore exercise) which we can schedule at your convenience.

Action items we need from you to finalize scheduling:
1) Preferred 2-hour witness window (local timezone) — give 2 options.
2) Any additional format you need the runbook extracts in (PDF/Markdown).
3) Names/emails of any external auditors you want invited to the witness.

If helpful, Ben (copied) can provide the variation matrix and a short checklist for the witness steps.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood_rto_rpo_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), runbook-extracts.txt (text), kvs-snapshot-times.csv (CSV)]
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@clearwaybank.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: controls@clearwaybank.com
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ClearWay DR evidence: RTO/RPO mapping and witness plan

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the package — quick follow-ups:
1) Can you provide a short matrix that maps each customer-observable endpoint to the specific RTO/RPO value and the evidence artifact (log name / file) we should look at during the witness? A single spreadsheet row per endpoint is perfect.
2) For the witness we prefer a 30–60 minute technical session + 30 minutes for questions. Can you propose two slots between Oct 4–8 (our team is booked the week of Oct 11). Prefer mornings ET.
3) We may also request a SOC 2 coverage snapshot showing whether the DR controls are in-scope for our most recent period — if that’s possible to share, please add it.

Also tagging controls@clearwaybank.com for their intake.

Regards,

Lena Ortiz
Director, Third-Party Risk
ClearWay Bank
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@clearwaybank.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWay DR evidence: RTO/RPO mapping and witness plan

Lena — thanks for the clarity. Inline answers and attached additional artifacts.

1) Spreadsheet: see rpo-variation-matrix.xlsx (attached) — one row per public endpoint; columns include target_RTO, measured_95th, evidence_log_path, and notes about fallback behavior. If you want a CSV export for ingestion, say the word.

2) Witness slots (we propose ET mornings):
   - Option A: Tue Oct 5 — 09:30–10:30 ET (tech session 30m + Q&A 30m)
   - Option B: Thu Oct 7 — 10:00–11:00 ET
We can shorten the tech demo to 20 minutes if you prefer a longer Q&A.

3) SOC 2 coverage: we can share a controls snapshot PDF showing which DR/BCP controls were in-scope for the last audit and the attestation dates — attaching a redacted page as part of the witness packet.

4) Warm-cache witness plan: warm-cache-witness-plan.md (attached) outlines steps we will run during the tech demo (invalidate local cache, simulate KV restore, show time-to-serve rewarm). Expect the full demo to take ~15–20 minutes. We will not expose any customer data in the demo.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4286 (for your intake folks).

Let us know which slot works and any additional auditors to invite.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: [rpo-variation-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB), warm-cache-witness-plan.md (MD, 8KB), soc2-dr-coverage-redacted.pdf (PDF, 300KB)]
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@clearwaybank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: controls@clearwaybank.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ClearWay DR evidence: RTO/RPO mapping and witness plan

Ben / Priya — good, thanks. We’ll take Option A: Tue Oct 5, 09:30–10:30 ET. Please send a calendar invite with the dial-in and any pre-reads (we will distribute to our controls panel).

For the SOC 2 snapshot, controls@clearwaybank.com will review when you attach. If you can provide a short one-paragraph summary of what the SOC 2 coverage means for DR (i.e., which policies/procedures map to our expectations), that will speed review.

I’ll circulate names for the controls panel by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Lena
